mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate compresses discount rates for equity valuation, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days regardless of other macro conditions.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in more than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 0.5% signals monetary tightening, which increases equity discount rates and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS exceeds 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of low unemployment (UNRATE < 4.0%) and rising industrial production (INDPRO > 100.5) indicates a robust economic expansion, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances when UNRATE < 4.0% and INDPRO > 100.5.

mechanism_narrative: In the late-cycle expansion regime defined by elevated inflation (CPIAUCSL > 280) and low unemployment (UNRATE < 4.0%), the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to impending monetary policy tightening.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances during the late-cycle expansion regime (CPIAUCSL > 280 and UNRATE < 4.0%).

mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate below 3.5% signals a tight labor market, which supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances when UNRATE is below 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production above 101.5 indicates strong manufacturing activity, which boosts corporate profits and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in more than 40% of instances when INDPRO exceeds 101.5.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts above 1650 thousand units signal robust consumer demand for housing, which correlates with broader economic strength and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances when HOUST exceeds 1650.

mechanism_narrative: In the strong consumer demand expansion regime defined by high housing starts (HOUST > 1650) and elevated retail sales (RSAFS > 620000), the S&P 500 experiences positive forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to sustained consumer spending.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances during the strong consumer demand expansion regime (HOUST > 1650 and RSAFS > 620000).
